_doc: godot-03.md: which legacy (non-Stable-Audio) game sounds are replaced, and how they are generated. The generation itself runs through the game's audio catalog (src/theroadragetrip/assets/audio/audio_catalog.json, tools/generate_audio.py); this file is the plan and its outcome. Formats: OGG Vorbis, mono one-shots, stereo loops, 44.1 kHz (catalog 'format').

replacements.reason: FLAC: Godot can't load it at runtime, so getting into the taxi was silent in the Godot client; the only legacy one-shot heard on every door event.
replacements.intended_use: Player gets into / out of the taxi (simulation.apply_enter_exit_vehicle), passenger boarding.
replacements.stable_audio_prompt: Compact sedan car door being opened: a sharp mechanical latch click, then the door swinging open with a soft hinge creak and rubber seal release, close exterior perspective, dry recording, isolated sound effect
variants: quick firm pull, crisp latch click
door opened from inside, handle clack then seal release
replacements.negative_prompt: music, melody, speech, voice, singing, low quality, distortion, clipping
replacements.status: generated, installed, playback verified, listening review passed
